title: Runaway 30A Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Located in Gulf Place "Runaway 30A" is an updated 3 bedroom townhome with private golf cart, 2 bikes, and steps to private community pool, shuffleboard, tennis courts and a 3 minute golf cart ride to the beach!
description_expanded: **SNOWBIRD PROMOTION- Save 50% PER NIGHT January and February for monthly stays!** HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS - 6 Seater Golf Cart available with a refundable $1000 security deposit - 2 adult sized beach cruisers - FREE Community Amenities at GULF PLACE- Private Beach Access, Recreational Paths, Pool, Tennis Courts, Shuffleboard Courts, Corn Hole - Walking distance to several shops and restaurants - Wifi and streaming TVs - Fully stocked kitchen complete with a standard drip coffee maker and Keurig - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) -Use of Owner's golf cart for $1000 refundable security deposit and signed liability waiver Runaway to 30A is the perfect vacation getaway! Situated in Gulf Place, an amazing walking community off 30A, with deeded beach access, 3 Pools, 2 of which are heated in the off season, tennis courts, shuffleboard, wonderful boutique shopping, services such as a day spa, YOLO, 30A store and more! Walk to some of the most amazing restaurants on 30A such as The Perfect Pig, Pizza By The Sea, Shunk Gulley, The Vue, Sunrise Coffee, Growlers Garage and Pecan Jack's Ice Cream! There is something at Gulf Place for everyone! Vacation at the beach in a pristine, updated townhome with all the modern conveniences! This townhome has everything you need, and is gorgeous! Step-less entry with a wide foyer, guest bedroom on the main with a custom barn door for privacy, gourmet kitchen with gorgeous counters and stainless appliances with large breakfast bar & bar stools! This is an open floor plan with the kitchen viewing the living room, so your entire party ,whether family or friends, can enjoy spending time together! The fully-equipped kitchen has everything you need to make a light lunch or cook a gourmet dinner. The large screened-in patio backs to the main pool and the tennis courts! It is an amazing location! The second floor has the oversized master bedroom & spa bath with a king bed, and spacious walk-in closet plus a balcony that overlooks both the main pool and the tennis courts! The spa bath includes a walk-in shower, tub and double vanities! The third bedroom is spacious with a Queen bed, and access to the 2nd bathroom! This bedroom includes a desk for those who need to study or work while on vacation! The laundry room is located on the main floor with a new full size, all in one, stackable. You have all the conveniences, amenities, and a gorgeous interior! Gulf Place is located off Scenic Hwy 30A which has an array of activities, beach communities, restaurants and more! Spend your days at the Beach or exploring the area! There is a lot to do for every age group! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: Floor 1 Queen bedroom, TV Half Bath Kitchen, Great Room with large TV Floor 2 King Master with En-Suite Bath with separate tub and shower, TV Queen bedroom, TV Hall bath with tub/shower combo FREE WIFI Sorry, No pets Must be 25 years to Rent

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
